approach: Modify `BaseSerializer.run_validation` to bind each child serializer with the matching instance from the `instance` list when `many=True`. Specifically, iterate through zipped children (`self.child`) and items (`data`), binding each child’s `instance` to the respective element from the provided `instance` iterable prior to validation.
hypothesis: During bulk validation with `many=True`, the validator incorrectly receives the full list of instances as `self.instance` instead of each individual instance per item.
